page.layout: One page of text in a single column; no margin notes. Running head at the top centre. Page number at top left. Digitiser watermark at bottom right (omitted). Last line is a catchword-like continuation "agno-" at the right, which is a line-end hyphenation, not a catchword.

main_text.p: in jure Canonico clare & aperte inveniatur, ejus dijudicatio in utroque foro ex jure Canonico petenda est; contra, causa decidenda est ex jure Civili, ubi in jure Canonico vel penitus nihil, vel obscure & ambigue decisum est. l. 1. & ibid. DD. de nov. oper. nunc. Abbas ad c. licet. n. 14. de for. comp. Marant. in Pract. p. 3. n. 73. Rebuff. ad constit. Reg. in Proem. gloss. 5. n. 126. Christinæus. decis. Belg. 54. n. 1. tom. 2. Si jus Civile & Canonicum contraria sunt, utrumque in suo foro, Civile in Imperio, Canonicum in Dominiis Ecclesiæ viget. Johan. Andr. ad c. 1. n. 5. de nov. oper. nunc. Card. Tusch. concluf. 277. n. 36. In causis peccati petenda decisio ex jure Canonico veluti in præscriptione, in qua bonam fidem continuam exigit jus Canonicum; ubi jus Civile-Canonico non est contrarium, dicitur ab eo approbatum, de quibus vide Arthur. Duck de auct. jur. Civil. lib. 1. c. 7. §. 11. 12. & 13. & Clarissimum meum Promotorem, Dn. Jacob. Brandmuller. Antecess. Basiliensem, in præliminaribus operis, de differ. juris Civil. & Canon. cap. 5. in fin. & 6. pag. 12. Manet hæc auctoritas quidem illibata, donec Deus lucem Euangelii sui seculo superiori benignissime restitueret; nisi quod anterioribus temporibus quidam etiā, sed pauci agno-

page.notes: The last line of the page ("tcrioribus temporibus quidam etiā, sed pauci") is printed in heavier type; "agno-" is set at the right as the line-end hyphen of the next word. Transcription of "Manfit" reads "Manfit" as printed (long s), corrected to "Manfit"; "etiā" carries a macron as printed. Some words in the first lines are faint or smudged; reading is best effort.
